title: Refactoring old code and improving myself
body: Going back through some of my older projects to refactor and update the code, cleaning up structure and fixing things I would do differently now. It's also my way of practising and levelling up as a developer.

title: Rebuilding this portfolio
body: Rewriting the site with a cleaner layout and three parts: About, Projects and Posts. Posts is where I will share what I am working on, what is in progress and what I plan next.

title: Shipped the Wonderland party mini-game
body: A browser mini-game themed on Alice in Wonderland, built for a group activity. Players try to place the item without looking at the character.

title: Auto-subtitle app for my videos
body: Planning a small app that transcribes my edited videos (Malay and English) and adds TikTok-style subtitles. Running locally first, possibly hosted later.
